step_by_step_reasoning: The diagram presents an architecture for 3D asset and image acquisition/optimization built by Scenesoftware. 1. Two client entry points are drawn: a laptop (UserConsumerWeb) and a mobile device (UserConsumerMobile). 2. Both send requests to Amazon API Gateway (ApiGateway). 3. API Gateway routes requests to Lambda functions: a group of 3D processing Lambda functions (top container) and an image processing Lambda function (middle). 4. Both Lambda nodes store metadata in Amazon RDS (RDS) and store processed assets/files in Amazon S3 (S3).
